title: A scoped gap counted a preprint and its published paper as two works

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project: the VERIFIER at stage pre, round 2

observed_failure: The gap said 'Among the 66 works retrieved'. Four of the 66 candidates were other versions of a listed work: an SSRN preprint and its conference paper, an arXiv preprint, its AAAI paper and a talk record. Candidates are keyed by DOI, and each version has its own DOI, so the count held 62 works.
expected_behavior: A candidate with the same normalized title as an earlier one, and the same first author or a year within one, is marked possible_version_of. It is not merged, the screening table shows it, and the search reports distinct works, the number a scoped gap should give.

resolution.summary: rce_index marks possible_version_of; lit_search prints distinct works; the screening table names the link

lessons: A count in a gap statement is a number like any other: it must trace to a record that means what the sentence says.
